summary: Iteration 3 frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844). All 14 features from the review request pass: 3 timestamp blocks (Alarmierung/Eintreffen/Einsatzende) with 6 inputs present, Dauer auto-computed correctly to '2 Std. 30 Min.', all 12 default Stichwort checkboxes render with correct testIDs, 'Test-Ereignis-XYZ' via input+add-btn is persisted and auto-selected (input clears), Organisation radio shows all 4 defaults and custom 'DRK' is added+selected (single-select confirmed via detail view showing only DRK). 'Situation an der Einsatzstelle' with Einsatzkräfte/Nachforderung checkboxes + input-nachforderung-sonstiges present. 'Setting' section has gut/optimiert checkboxes, input-setting-notiz, input-weitere-beobachtungen; old 'Trauer' chip absent. All 7 new Maßnahmen options render. Save enables only when Alarmierung Datum + ≥1 Stichwort set, then navigates to /einsatz/{id}; detail view shows 3 time blocks (ALARMIERUNG/EINTREFFEN/EINSATZENDE), Dauer '2 Std. 30 Min.', stichwort chips, DRK organisation, gut+optimiert. Einstellungen radio includes DRK; after save it pre-fills a new form (visual confirmed via inner-div count=3 on DRK radio). Custom tags shown with remove-custom-* testIDs; remove works. CSV export triggers download 'psnv-einsaetze-2026-08-25.csv'. Statistik shows metric-total=1, metric-month=0, metric-betroffene=1, metric-dauer='2 Std. 30 Min.' formatted, and Setting/Organisation/Häufigste Maßnahmen breakdown rows (visually confirmed). No React Native red-screen, no console errors detected during flow, no deprecated packages spotted in reviewed files.
critical_code_review_comments: mission-form.tsx is ~975 lines – consider extracting CheckList/RadioList/ChipRowInline sub-components into /src/components/form-inputs.tsx to stay under ~700 lines guideline.
storage.ts migrate() is resilient; verified legacy fields (einsatzDatum/einsatzZeit/stichwort/symptomeNotiz) fall back correctly.
duration.ts formatDuration returns '—' for 0/negative – matches spec (initial display and empty end).
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage before test; created 1 mission with custom stichwort 'Test-Ereignis-XYZ' and custom org 'DRK'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end via Playwright on mobile viewport. If further changes touch mission-form or storage, re-run /app/test_reports/iteration_3 flow (clear localStorage first). Note that innerText matching against uppercased section titles will fail because of CSS textTransform:uppercase – rely on testIDs or explicit uppercase probes ('ALARMIERUNG','SETTING','HÄUFIGSTE STICHWORTE').
